source.statement: Mike selected "Approve wider sampling (Recommended)" after reviewing the prepared minimal-width big-endian rejection sampler: preserve every one-byte result and byte consumption for at most 256 eligible lines; for 257 lines 01 00 selects line 257, FF FF is rejected, and following tokens consume subsequent bytes. The isolated candidate exhaustively checked every two-byte input. This approves the FN-021 clarification in FILENAME-GENERATION-001 0.2.1 within contract 0.3.1. Other packages and all activation/release gates are unchanged.
